title: Cause of Recent Oil Leak at Police Coast Guard's Brani Regional Base
what_it_is: Cause of Recent Oil Leak at Police Coast Guard's Brani Regional Base

sections.label: Brani Base oil leak stopped
sections.summary: Police Coast Guard was alerted to a possible oil leak at Brani Base, and a contractor isolated the leaking hose, stopping the leak at about 3.40 pm.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: On 5 February 2025, at about 3.25 pm, the Police Coast Guard (PCG) was alerted by the Maritime Port Authority of Singapore (MPA) of a possible oil leak from Brani Base after MPA had detected oil sheens near Sentosa Gateway.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: While PCG was checking for the oil leak, a contractor who was performing unrelated works in the vicinity saw oil leaking from a fuel hose at one of the pontoons at Brani Base.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: The contractor isolated the main valve to the leaking hose and the leak was stopped at about 3.40 pm.

sections.label: Leak source and first leak time
sections.summary: After confirming the leak source, PCG investigations and CCTV checks established the affected hose first leaked at about 11.40 am that morning.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Home Affairs (Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: After PCG had confirmed the source of the leak on 5 February 2025, it carried out further investigations and CCTV checks, and established that the affected hose had first leaked at about 11.40 am that morning.

sections.label: Leak cause and maintenance schedule
sections.summary: PCG found the leak stopped at about 12.20 pm and restarted at about 2.47 pm, caused by a damaged fuel hose with micro-cracks; last maintenance was 17 January 2025.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Through PCG’s subsequent investigation and retrospective CCTV checks, PCG discovered that the leak had stopped on its own at about 12.20 pm but restarted at about 2.47 pm.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: Based on PCG’s investigations, the leak was caused by a damaged fuel hose connecting the wharf's fuel distribution network to the fuel dispenser on a pontoon.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: PCG’s preliminary assessment is that the fuel hose developed micro-cracks due to cyclical stresses during routine coiling and uncoiling, which eventually led to a tear that caused the fuel spillage.

sentences.speaker: Assoc Prof Dr Muhammad Faishal Ibrahim
sentences.text: The last maintenance check was conducted on 17 January 2025 and the next inspection was scheduled for the week of 10 February 2025.
